title: Fold a paper aeroplane
instruction: Fold the uncreased sheet into a paper aeroplane and leave it on the table with both grippers released.
setup: Development draft. Flat 210 × 154 mm uncreased sheet on the station table; no pre-creased or weakened fold lines. Full setup is not validated.
scoring: Not implemented: the development scorer returns zero for every outcome.
fidelity: Unvalidated uniform triangular-sheet prototype with plastic dihedral bending and layer contact. It has not produced a credible complete plane; do not submit.
scores: No native runs. CPU previews are not submission evidence.
